text.tspan: Wage of craftsmen relative to that of laborers in England 1220 to 2000
Craftsmen are skilled and specialised workers, for example, carpenters. Laborers are typically unskilled workers
who work in the building trade.

tspan.tspan: The Condition of the Working Class in England, 1209-2004, Clark (2005)
